flow-definition.description: THROWAWAY reproducer pipeline for Percona-Lab/jenkins-pipelines PR 4532 review (check-oracle-cpu). Runs repro/Jenkinsfile from nogueiraanderson/probe-pr4532-oracle-cpu against a read-only clone of the PR tree, mock Oracle on loopback, Slack stubbed. No cron trigger. Owner: Anderson Nogueira. Delete after the review.
